subject: Renewal pricing proposal — stepwise commit to usage ladder
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@pinestreet.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal pricing proposal — stepwise commit to usage ladder

Hi Lydia,

Thanks again for the productive calls last week. Attached is a pragmatic renewal structure that balances PineStreet's desire for short-term price stability with Redwood's need for predictable capacity economics. High-level proposal: 

- Term: 12 months (Jan 1, 2028 — Dec 31, 2028).
- Commit floor: 110M tokens annualized (billed as quarterly tranches).
- Stepwise usage ladder: if usage crosses predefined thresholds during a rolling 90-day window we automatically shift the next invoice band:
  • Tier A (110M–180M): $0.0008 / token (effective rate)
  • Tier B (180M–300M): $0.00072 / token (5% economics improvement)
  • Tier C (>300M): $0.00065 / token (further discount, requires commit uplift)
- Top-up credits: to smooth transition, Redwood will apply a one-time onboarding credit of $25,000 applied to Q1 invoices if PineStreet confirms the PO by Dec 15.
- Price hold: we’ll lock the Tier A rate for the first 6 months, even if usage spikes, to give you runway.
- Burst pool: additional burst capacity available at a capped premium rate; usage above Top Tier billed monthly with 30-day notice to enable capacity planning.

Operational notes: quarterly true-ups, monthly usage reports, and a 30-day SLA for support escalations under Dedicated onboarding. Attached term sheet (PineStreet_Renewal_TermSheet_v2.pdf) has the table and an example invoicing cadence.

Next steps: can you confirm three things by end of day Monday?
1) Target annual token estimate you expect to send us for 2028 (best-effort).
2) Whether procurement needs a fixed-dollar PO for Q1 only, or a PO that references the quarterly true-up logic.
3) Any legal must-haves to include before we route to DocuSign (e.g., specific data residency or audit clauses).

If it helps, I can carve out 30 minutes Tuesday to walk the finance and procurement teams through the term sheet.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachment: PineStreet_Renewal_TermSheet_v2.pdf
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@pinestreet.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@pinestreet.io>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing proposal — stepwise commit to usage ladder

Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear framing. A few immediate questions from our side: 

1) The 110M token floor is higher than we expected coming out of the pilot. Can you do an initial starter tranche at 70M for Q1 with a contractual escalator to the 110M floor starting in Q2 if utilization trends as we expect?
2) Procurement is asking for a fixed-dollar PO for Q1 so they can close the quarter. They can sign a quarterly PO referencing the true-up, but they need a hard number for Jan–Mar. Can you give an estimated Q1 invoice amount under the starter tranche + onboarding credit?
3) SLA confirmation: we need the 30-day escalation path documented in the term sheet and a commitment to 99.5% monthly availability for inference endpoints used in production.

I’ve attached our standard PO template (PO_Template.pdf). Also looping in procurement in CC.

Thanks — let me know your availability for a short working session with finance and procurement; Tuesday afternoon PST works for our side.

— Lydia Chen
Head of Platform Ops
PineStreet Labs
lydia.chen@pinestreet.io
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@pinestreet.io>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing proposal — stepwise commit to usage ladder

Lydia —

Thanks — totally reasonable asks. Quick responses inline and an alternative that should be easy for procurement to commit to: 

1) Starter tranche: we can do 70M tokens for Q1. If we see >90% utilization of the tranche across any 60-day window, the contract moves to the 110M quarterly-equivalent floor for the remainder of the year (we’ll capture that with a simple amendment). This gives PineStreet a lower short-term commitment while preserving fairness on capacity.

2) Estimated Q1 invoice under starter tranche: Tier A rate ($0.0008) applied to 70M = $56,000. Apply onboarding credit of $25,000 = net $31,000 (invoice would show the credit line separately). We’ll confirm final tax/billing language with Marissa, copied.

3) SLA: we’ll add the 99.5% monthly availability clause into the term sheet and document the 30-day escalation path. Dylan will sync operational compliance details to ensure the monitoring hooks are in place.

Additional concession to speed the signature: if PineStreet signs the PO for Q1 by Dec 15 we’ll include a one-time usage buffer of 15M tokens (no charge) to accommodate launch spikes during ramp (expires after Q1).

If that aligns, I’ll update the term sheet and circulate a redline to your procurement. Can you confirm Tuesday 2:00pm PST for a 30-minute session?

Thanks —

Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@pinestreet.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@pinestreet.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal pricing proposal — stepwise commit to usage ladder

Kimberly —

That works for us. Q1 PO will reference the starter tranche (70M) and we’ll include language that points to the quarterly true-up mechanic. Procurement will review the $31,000 estimate and confirm any local tax lines, but they can issue the PO next week once Marissa confirms the invoice format.

We’ll take the no-charge 15M buffer — very helpful for launch. Tuesday 2:00pm PST confirmed for the working session; I’ll ask procurement to join and I’ll bring our finance lead.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Lydia

Attachment: PO_Template.pdf
